Type: plug-in cone wall sconce
Use: reading light; bedroom, living room, home office; mounted beside a bed or chair
Style: mid-century modern, retro, minimalist
Materials: black metal shade with white interior, brushed nickel arm and oval backplate
Colors: black, silver nickel, white
Shape: tapered cone shade with nickel band, curved slim arm, oval wall plate with rocker switch, medium size
Feel: graphic, crisp, retro
Goes with: walnut wood, white or grey walls, metal accents; mid-century or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Plug-In Light Wall Mounted Sconce - 11 x 8 x 16.5 Inches, Black and Brushed Nickel
product.description: 11"W x 8"D x 16.5"H Black metal shade, brushed nickel arm and wall plate Convenient plug-in sconce provides soft light. Rotary on/off switch. Bulb not included Easily assembled and mounted on wall Intended for indoor use only This mid-century modern wall sconce is sleek and easy to install. Just mount on the wall and plug the cord into a standard outlet. With a black metal cone shade and brushed-nickel hardware, it will brighten up any room or reading area.
